name: ddr_kevin
tag: AAA'd Butterfly. it happened. u weren't there.
loc: Tilt arcade, second machine from the left (the good pad)
about: on june 3rd at approximately 4:40pm i AAA'd Butterfly on the Tilt arcade machine. every arrow. perfect. no witnesses. doug (arcade guy) was in the back dealing with the claw machine. i have made peace with this. (i have not made peace with this.) i wear my sweatband to school for readiness purposes — you never know when a machine will appear. home training setup: a pillow with masking tape arrows, which my mom calls 'the carpet situation.' my legs are two separate athletes and i am merely their coach.

interests.General: stamina training, quarter management, reading the song wheel, respecting the pad, the sweatband (official), the home pad (pillow, tape arrows), doug's nods, ankle support, crossover steps, the good pad
interests.Music: anything 140+ bpm, smile.dk (butterfly obviously), captain jack, dj sammy, max 300 (it's a song AND a threat), nikki's remixes (180 bpm) (dangerous), sandstorm (dave plays it while i practice) (it works)
interests.Movies: whatever's on at the mall theater between sessions. the karate kid (training montage) (i pause it and stretch)
interests.Television: the tv above the prize counter at Tilt (same 20 minutes) (300 times), ninja warrior (those guys have DDR calves), pump it up demos on the machine next to mine (the enemy) (respectfully)
interests.Books: the DDR songlist printout from the machine (folded in my wallet), a book about stretching my mom got me (i actually read it) (it's good)
interests.Heroes: doug. my left calf. my right calf. chad (cheered so loud he got asked to step back). nikki (the mix). whoever invented the safety bar (i don't use it) (but it's there)

wall.text: KEVIN i watched you play saturday and CHEERED so loud doug asked me to step back from the machine. YOUR LEGS are a sports highlight my man. hall of fame stuff
the tilt DDR cab runs a locked refresh rate with basically zero input lag, which is why your scores are real and home-console players live a comfortable lie. anyway you owe me a quarter.
your 180bpm practice mix is DONE. warning: i added reverb to the arrow sounds. u will transcend. possibly ascend. stretch first.
dude ur shins and my shins should start a support group lol. iced mine 2day, ur turn 2 bring the frozen peas. respect the grind 4ever

replies: thanks dude. this comment gets a PERFECT rating. no greats. all perfects.
appreciate it!! *wipes forehead with the official sweatband*
your kind words have been added to my pre-game hype ritual. it's getting long but it's worth it.
combo continues. thank you for not breaking my combo.
thanksAdd: yooo welcome to the list malten!! standing offer: free DDR lesson at Tilt, any saturday. first song's on me (i keep a quarter jar for exactly this). bring ankle support. i'm serious about the ankle support.
ambient: the school stairs are just DDR with worse music. took them double-step style. late to class but ON RHYTHM.
doug nodded at me today. not a big nod. but a nod. we move up in this world one nod at a time.
practiced on the home pad (pillow, tape arrows) til 11pm. downstairs neighbor did 'broom on ceiling' back. i choose to hear it as a duet.
saltyDm: denied!! hey, it's cool, it's cool. even i failed Butterfly the first 40 times. the door's open whenever you wanna run it back. i'll be at the arcade. (i'm always at the arcade.) (doug says hi.) (he didn't. but he would.)

keywords.ddr: ok you said it so now i get to ask: light, standard, or heavy? be honest. there's no wrong answer except the dishonest one. also come to Tilt saturday.
keywords.arcade: THE arcade or AN arcade? because if it's Tilt, second machine from the left, tell the pad kevin says hello and tell doug i said thanks for the nod.

wes: wes i need ONE of your seven CRTs for frame-perfect home pad practice, and i'm prepared to offer a full sweatband set in trade. think about it. sleep on it. (you could sleep ON a CRT. you have SEVEN.)
you talk about wavedashing exactly the way i talk about crossover steps, so basically we're the same athlete running different software. respect, from my scene to your scene.
derek: derek if you get to claim a 'bigger gap' then i get to claim the Butterfly AAA, and MY claim has a witness. (doug. doug counts. doug was in the BUILDING.)
come to Tilt saturday, there's a pad with your name on it. skaters have insane ankles. you'd be terrifying on heavy mode and honestly i'm already scared. this is an invitation AND a warning.
banana: BANANA i timed your posts and you type at a natural 172 bpm. do you understand what this means?? DDR. you. saturday. i'll bring potassium. (bananas. i mean i'll bring bananas.)
awake 37 hours is one (1) good arcade session in my units. hydrate, stretch, and know that the machine respects you already.
herp: herp came to the arcade, stood PERFECTLY on beat next to the machine for two full songs, did not play, then left. most respectful spectator in Tilt history. doug was moved.
herp herp to you too, man. see you saturday. (i don't know what we agreed to but i felt it.)
paige: PAIGE. u have a camera. u are ALWAYS at the mall. u are 40 feet from Tilt at any given time. i need u at the second machine from the left, saturday, 2pm. Butterfly. heavy. 'pics or it didn't happen.' MAKE IT HAPPEN
u took a fisheye of me mid-song and my legs are a blur and my sweatband is in focus. that's the truest picture anyone's taken of me. it's my default now. thank u. doug saw it. doug nodded
josh: josh u said halo is 'cardio for the thumbs' and honestly?? i laughed and then i thought about it and now i'm mad. come to Tilt. i'll show u cardio. bring ur thumbs

ok i came to youth group and u beat wes at halo on a projector and then 40 people said 'good game' to each other. nobody says 'good game' at the arcade. doug just nods. i think u guys might be onto something. i'll be back saturday (after Tilt)
smoove: smoove u put the arrow sounds from Butterfly on ur track and now i can't hear it without my legs moving. i was in CHURCH (josh's thing). my legs moved. it's ur fault. it's a good track

'feat. kevin' — i'm on the music page. i did not sing. i did not rap. u recorded me saying 'perfect' 40 times at the arcade and it's the CHORUS. doug is in the background. DOUG IS ON THE TRACK. we did it

statuses: is stretching. always stretching. you have never seen me not stretching.
is 2 perfects away from greatness (literally, the machine said so, i have it memorized)
is wearing the sweatband to the family reunion. grandma gets it. grandma has always gotten it.
is 2 perfects from greatness and one quarter from broke. the machine takes both
took the mall escalator on beat. up escalator. down escalator. security did not stop me. they nodded. everyone nods eventually
some people say 'ddr isn't a sport' and then grab the safety bar in 8 seconds. i'm not naming anyone. the pad forgives. i forgive slower. (derek.)
is at Tilt. doug said 'you again.' i said 'me again.' we're close now

bulletins.subject: DDR MEETUP @ TILT — SATURDAY 2PM (i'll be there at noon)
bulletins.body: all skill levels welcome!! i will personally teach anyone the basics, doug has agreed to 'not mind,' and nikki is providing a warmup mix (180bpm, do NOT start with it). bring quarters, water, and humility. the machine takes all three.

bulletins.subject: WITNESS DRIVE: the Butterfly AAA (june 3, ~4:40pm)
bulletins.body: if you were at Tilt on june 3rd around 4:40pm and saw a kid in a sweatband achieve perfection on Butterfly, please come forward. no reward except being part of history. doug was in the back (claw machine emergency, not his fault). the search continues.

hometown: Mentor, OH (Tilt is in the mall) (second machine from the left)
zodiac: Aries. starxgazer said we 'charge at things' and that malten is one too. correct. i charge at arrows. hi malten
status: is stretching. right now. reading this? still stretching.
hereFor: Friends (DDR meetups). Networking (a witness). Dating (someone who can hold my quarters while i play) (that's romance)
blogTitle: PERFECT COMBO: the training log (and the witness search)
meet: whoever made Butterfly. doug (i've met him) (i'd like to meet him AGAIN, as a witness). anyone who was at Tilt on june 3rd around 4:40pm. the guy who holds the world record on Max 300 so i can shake his hand and then check his ankles
pcComments: great pic. your stance is wide. that's a heavy-mode stance. you'd be good. come saturday
PERFECT. no greats. all perfects. commented as promised
i can tell from this pic that u have good ankles. that's a compliment where i come from (the arcade)
nice pic!! did doug take this?? no. doug doesn't take pics. that's his one flaw
combo continues. ur pic did not break my combo. that's the highest praise i have
